mechanisms.name: suppression of Ni4Ti3 coarsening and decomposition

evidence.quote: This is attributed to the inhibitory effect of the Hf element, preventing the coarsening and decomposition of the Ni4Ti3 phase.
The occurrence of the white HfO2 phase in the 3Hf alloy can be ascribed to the role of Hf in capturing oxygen within the alloy, effectively suppressing the formation of the Ti2Ni phase.
